extraction.Name: Luther Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 26, 1920, by Luther Wright
extraction.Buyer: Wright and his wife conveyed the land to R. E. Minger by deed showing consideration to be $6667.50
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739646 issued; Lots 1 and 2 and South half of Northeast quarter, section 1, township 99, north of range 78; receipt signed by allottee April 5, 1920; land contract dated April 26, 1920 between R. E. Minger and Luther Wright shows that Wright agrees to sell the land for $6667.50, as follows: $2000 in cash, $1000 represented by one Buick roadster the delivery of which is acknowledged by Wright, and $3667.50 to be paid on or before July 1, 1920; subject to certain case between Luther Wright and Joseph E. Holton of Jordan
